title: python-pipx missing required dependency
body: (Posting here as registration on the Arch GitLab is currently disabled) The Python "pipx" package (python-pipx in the Arch repos) requires the Python "filelock" package, but python-filelock is not listed as a dependency of python-pipx. This can result in pipx invocations on Arch crashing with an error traceback if the system doesn't already have python-filelock installed for something else. Also, uv is currently listed as an "extra" dependency of "pipx" in its Python package metadata, but uv is not listed as an optional dependency of python-pipx. I hope these deficiencies in the python-pipx metadata can be resolved soon.
